For companies

Sell your company’s data to AI labs. $100K–$2M+ per approved package.

Learn more →

FAQ

What is an AI training job?

AI labs hire domain experts to write, review and grade the examples their models learn from. A lawyer might evaluate legal reasoning; a physician might check clinical answers. The work is paid hourly, usually as a flexible contract.

How much do AI training jobs pay?

Across 307 open roles, the median top-of-range rate is $90/hr and the highest is $400/hr. Specialist credentials such as medical licences, bar admission or PhDs command the highest rates.

How do I apply?

Each role links to micro1, which runs a short AI interview to verify your expertise, then matches you to client projects. There is no fee to apply.

How does Artificial Jobs make money?

Apply links include our micro1 referral code. If you are hired, micro1 may pay us a referral fee. It costs you nothing and does not change your pay.
